'''Greymane Tower''' is the towering seat of power of [[House Greymane]], located within the heart of [[Gilneas City]]. It is where King [[Genn Greymane]] of [[Gilneas (kingdom)|Gilneas]] makes his court. As of recently, the elderly King Greymane has fallen deep in despair with the death of his beloved wife [[Mia Greymane|Mia]], as well as believing that his children [[Liam Greymane|Liam]] and [[Tess Greymane|Tess]] were lost at sea. As such, the kingdom is de facto ran by the [[Regent-Lords of Gilneas]], Lord [[Mortimer Harlow]] and Lady [[Celia Harlow]].
